name: Get marketing site header menu
description: Call this when an agent needs the marketing/corporate website's top navigation tree — menu tab names, item titles, slugs and link URLs — for example to resolve where a public Brevo page lives before navigating to it. This serves the public corp site chrome, not the logged-in product UI: it carries no account, contact or campaign data, so use a contacts, campaigns or lists read action instead for anything account-specific, and use the feature-toggle or plan-info reads instead to learn what the current account can access.

locale.description: Language/locale path segment that prefixes the WordPress REST route and selects the translated menu, observed as "pt" in the path /pt/wp-json/brevo/v1/header/. Titles in the response come back in this language.

menu.description: Top-level navigation entries, in display order.

ID.description: WordPress post ID of the menu entry.

title.description: Display label for the entry, in the requested locale.

post_title.description: Underlying WordPress post title, usually the same as title.

post_name.description: Slug of the menu entry, e.g. "platform" or "capabilities".

description.description: Optional descriptive text shown under the entry; empty string when unset.

url.description: Destination link for the entry; empty string for entries that only open a submenu.

icon.description: Icon for the entry, false when none is configured.

superscript_label.description: Small badge text shown beside the label, e.g. for "new"; empty string when unset.

enable_item_descriptions_row_layout.description: Layout flag: render child items as rows showing their descriptions.

enable_without_description_column_layout.description: Layout flag: render child items as columns without descriptions.

number_of_items_to_display.description: How many child items to show, as a string, e.g. "4".

hide_on_smaller_screens.description: Whether the entry is hidden on narrow viewports.

menu_tab_name.description: Name of the mega-menu tab this entry belongs to, e.g. "platform" or "default".

child_items.description: Nested menu entries with the same shape, recursively.
